reviews.title: Amazing PSU
reviews.comment: This power supply is a beast - quiet, cool, and quality. First time buying from Be Quiet! and I'm really impressed. Installation was a breeze and cables are very easy to manage. I wish the cables felt a little more quality because they are quite ugly and are not braided. Personally I feel like braided PSUs feel better and will last longer, but maybe that's just me. It's not a deal breaker, just a pet peeve. The fan doesn't get loud, honestly I can't even tell when my computer is even on sometimes. Keeps my GPU and fans running solid when running games. I'm using an intel 7-13700KF, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Ti, 32G of Ram and this thing runs great with room to upgrade later on! As for the lifespan, I can't say for sure since I've had it running for about a week, but I've heard good things about this PSU. I've been on a quiet PSU hunt for a good month now, and I can say this is the winner. Really happy with my purchase.
reviews.author: LS

reviews.title: Quiet, Works, Easy to Connect
reviews.comment: Box was not damaged, the cables were a bit stiff such as for the motherboard and gpu but still manageable, weight is pretty light, easy to setup too. I used it for my 5070 and as I turned on my pc it made my fans quiter than before. As for the psu it’s completely silent. Will update as time goes on, but works well instantly out of box.
reviews.author: Chris R

reviews.title: Excellent power supply. No compromises and very quiet!
reviews.comment: This PSU just "feels" like a quality unit. Designed in Germany, manufactured in Taiwan. It's actually rated higher than advertised for efficiency. Cybenetics certifies the 13M 750W as Platinum efficiency and A++ for noise profile. When combined with my Noctua cooler, undervolted 9800X3D, and custom case fan profiles, my tower makes almost ZERO noise. The zero-RPM fan is great, and even when it does spin under load it's quieter than the other fans. I expect to be able to use this power supply for the entire 10 year duration that it's under warranty, and it will likely be used in 2 or 3 more builds in the future.
reviews.author: Randy

reviews.title: Works Great!
reviews.comment: This thing has been awesome in my new build so far. I did have a little trouble getting it to work at first, and be quiet  support never even answered me back, when I asked them some questions so that may be a problem if I ever need them. I figured it out on my own eventually though. It has been working perfectly since then. It has a ten year warranty and is built like a tank. This thing is heavy. I can't tell you if it's quiet or not, because my case fans are too noisy, to tell. I like the modularity of it, you only have to use the cables you need. I could have used one more power cable (PCIE I think) but my motherboard works with just one. I'm not a gamer so I really don't need the second one. I doubt I will ever need that much power draw.
